scripts.dev:all: pnpm -r --parallel --filter admin --filter oa --filter pmis --fail-if-no-match run dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter admin --filter oa --filter pmis --fail-if-no-match run typecheck
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter admin --filter oa --filter pmis --fail-if-no-match run build
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages scripts package.json tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm contract && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm format:check
